name: Reheat
body:
Not everybody can just micro-wave their hands and the food’s still good.

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level culinarian.

Benefit(s): You can use a standard action to extend the duration of unconsumed servings of a meal by up to 1 round per 2 culinarian levels if the meal’s duration has ended since the end of your last turn. This destroys 1 of the remaining servings of that meal each time its duration is extended.
